|  Module Number:   | **14036**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Scientific Presentation in Life Sciences**  |  
|  Wissenschaftliche Präsentation in den Lebenswissenschaften   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty GW - Faculty of Health Sciences Brandenburg   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. rer. nat. habil. von Maltzahn, Julia 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | After successful completion of the module the students are able to:- display scientific content/data as a poster presentation (generation of the poster)- presentation of scientific content/data as a poster presentation- presentation of scientific content/data as a scientific short talk (20min)  |  
| Contents:  | The oral presentation of scientific content and current research data is an important aspect in the life sciences and related studies. In this module the students learn about the different forms of scientfic presentation, namely poster presentation and short talks. Therefore, the students prepare a scientific poster and present the data/figures displayed there in oral form. Furthermore, the students prepare a scientific short talk which is presented in front of the whole course. We will discuss the presentation of the data (display) as well as the presentation style.   |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Studies in biotechnology, chemistry or something similar or high school degree with biologie or chemistry.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | none  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Exercise / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Seminar / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 135 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | scientific publications from the life sciences (the participants choose the topics and literature on their own)  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * generation of the scientific poster (1/3)
  * presentation of the scientific poster (1/3)
  * scientific short talk (1/3)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | 15  |
